Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recording is for claim review purposes. Can you please
state your full name for the record?
A: I'd rather not give my full name on a recording, but you already have it on the claim file.
Q: That's fine. Can you describe where you were when the collision happened?
A: I was driving through Pasadena, Texas, and I was making a left turn at an intersection with a green light, or I
thought it was green when I started.
Q: What happened as you began the turn?
A: I was partway into the turn when another vehicle came through from the opposite direction and hit the front
passenger side of my car. I didn't see it coming until it was right there.
Q: Did you brake or swerve before impact?
A: I hit the brakes, but there wasn't much time. The impact pushed my car sideways.
Q: Were you injured?
A: Yes. My lower back started hurting right away. It's a strain, and the doctor said I should rest it and avoid lifting for a
few weeks.
Q: Have you seen a medical provider since the accident?
A: Yes, I went to urgent care the same day and I've had follow-up visits since.
Q: Thank you. Is there anything you would like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I'm still having stiffness when I sit for long periods. I'd like the claim handled as quickly as possible.
Q: Thank you for your time. This concludes the recorded statement.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
